arxiv-1806-04844.title: Two-photon exchange effects in e + ​ e − → π + ​ π − e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrow\pi^{+}\pi^{-} and time-like pion electromagnetic form factor
arxiv-1806-04844.creator: Hong-Yu Chen, Hai-Qing Zhou School of Physics, Southeast University, NanJing 211189, China
arxiv-1806-04844.description: Abstract The two-photon-exchange (TPE) effects in the process e + ​ e − → π + ​ π − e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrow\pi^{+}\pi^{-} at large momentum transfer are discussed within the perturbative QCD (pQCD). The contributions from the twist-2 and twist-3 distribution amplitudes (DAs) of pion are considered in the estimation.

arxiv-1910-03917.title: Clause Set Cycles and Induction Thanks: Supported by the Vienna Science and Technology Fund (WWTF) project VRG12-004
arxiv-1910-03917.creator: Stefan Hetzl, Jannik Vierling
arxiv-1910-03917.description: Abstract . In this article we relate a family of methods for automated inductive theorem proving based on cycle detection in saturation-based provers to well-known theories of induction. To this end we introduce the notion of clause set cycles—a formalism abstracting a certain type of cyclic dependency between clause sets.

arxiv-2009-09452.creator: F. Abudinén, I. Adachi, R. Adak, K. Adamczyk, P. Ahlburg, J. K. Ahn, H. Aihara, N. Akopov, A. Aloisio, F. Ameli, L. Andricek, N. Anh Ky, D. M. Asner, H. Atmacan, V. arxiv-2202-02351.title: An explicit dual control approach for constrained reference tracking of uncertain linear systems
arxiv-2202-02351.creator: Anilkumar Parsi, Andrea Iannelli, Roy S. Smith
arxiv-2202-02351.description: Abstract A finite horizon optimal tracking problem is considered for linear dynamical systems subject to parametric uncertainties in the state-space matrices and exogenous disturbances. A suboptimal solution is proposed using a model predictive control (MPC) based explicit dual control approach which enables active uncertainty learning.

arxiv-2206-00133.title: Pre-training via Denoising for Molecular Property Prediction
arxiv-2206-00133.creator: Sheheryar Zaidi Michael Schaarschmidt, James Martens Hyunjik Kim Yee Whye Teh Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez, Peter Battaglia Razvan Pascanu Jonathan Godwin, Equal contribution. Work done during an internship at DeepMind.Correspondence to: szaidi@stats.ox.ac.uk, mschaarschmidt@google.com
arxiv-2206-00133.description: Abstract Many important problems involving molecular property prediction from 3D structures have limited data, posing a generalization challenge for neural networks. In this paper, we describe a pre-training technique based on denoising that achieves a new state-of-the-art in molecular property prediction by utilizing large datasets of 3D molecular structures at equilibrium to learn meaningful representations for downstream tasks.

arxiv-2210-03029.title: Efficiently Enhancing Zero-Shot Performance of Instruction Following Model via Retrieval of Soft Prompt
arxiv-2210-03029.creator: Seonghyeon Ye, Joel Jang, Doyoung Kim, Yongrae Jo, Minjoon Seo
arxiv-2210-03029.description: Abstract Enhancing the zero-shot performance of instruction-following models requires heavy computation, either by scaling the total number of training datasets or the model size. In this work, we explore how retrieval of soft prompts obtained through prompt tuning can efficiently assist hard prompts in zero-shot task generalization.

arxiv-2307-02078.description: Abstract . Contrastive learning has recently been introduced into neural topic models to improve latent semantic discovery. However, existing NTMs with contrastive learning suffer from the sample bias problem owing to the word frequency-based sampling strategy, which may result in false negative samples with similar semantics to the prototypes.

arxiv-2311-02725.title: Search for high-mass exclusive diphoton production with tagged protons in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2311-02725.description: Abstract A search is presented for high-mass exclusive diphoton production via photon-photon fusion in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV in events where both protons survive the interaction. The analysis utilizes data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 103 \fbinv collected in 2016–2018 with the central CMS detector and the CMS and TOTEM precision proton spectrometer (PPS).

arxiv-2406-06087.title: GAIA: Rethinking Action Quality Assessment for AI-Generated Videos
arxiv-2406-06087.creator: Zijian Chen, Wei Sun, Yuan Tian, Jun Jia, Zicheng Zhang, Jiarui Wang, Ru Huang, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai, Wenjun Zhang
arxiv-2406-06087.description: Abstract Assessing action quality is both imperative and challenging due to its significant impact on the quality of AI-generated videos, further complicated by the inherently ambiguous nature of actions within AI-generated video (AIGV). Current action quality assessment (AQA) algorithms predominantly focus on actions from real specific scenarios and are pre-trained with normative action features, thus rendering them inapplicable in AIGVs.

arxiv-2502-19406.title: Single-shot and two-shot decoding with generalized bicycle codes
arxiv-2502-19406.creator: Hsiang-Ku Lin, Xingrui Liu, Pak Kau Lim, Leonid P. Pryadko
arxiv-2502-19406.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hsiang-Ku Lin, Xingrui Liu, Pak Kau Lim, Leonid P. Pryadko. Generalized-bicycle (GB) quantum error-correcting codes have naturally redundant minimum-weight stabilizer generators. To use this redundancy, we constructed several short GB codes with relatively large dimensions, distances, and syndrome distances, also admitting fault-tolerant near-time-optimal syndrome measurement schedules. We simulated their performance both under phenomenological noise and standard circuit noise, using sliding window sequential decoding protocol covering T ≥ 1 T\geq 1 measurement rounds at a time, based on an in-house binary BP+OSD decoder.

arxiv-2504-00590.title: A planar rotor trapped and coupled to the vibrational modes of an ion crystal
arxiv-2504-00590.creator: Monika Leibscher, Ferdinand Schmidt-Kaler, Christiane P. Koch
arxiv-2504-00590.description: Abstract Planar rotors can be realized by confining molecular ions or charged nanoparticles together with atomic ions in a Paul trap. We study the case of molecular ions or charged nanoparticles that have an electric dipole moment which couples to modes of the common vibrational motion in the trap.

pmc-10582231.title: Epicardial placement of human placental membrane protects from heart injury in a swine model of myocardial infarction
pmc-10582231.creator: Rinku S. Skaria, Marissa A. Lopez‐Pier, Brij S. Kathuria, Christian J. Leber, Paul R. Langlais, Shravan G. Aras, Zain I. Khalpey, Pamela G. Hitscherich, Evangelia Chnari, Marc Long, Jared M. Churko, Raymond B. Runyan, John P. Konhilas
pmc-10582231.description: Cardiac ischemic reperfusion injury (IRI) is paradoxically instigated by reestablishing blood‐flow to ischemic myocardium typically from a myocardial infarction (MI). Although revascularization following MI remains the standard of care, effective strategies remain limited to prevent or attenuate IRI. We hypothesized that epicardial placement of human placental amnion/chorion (HPAC) grafts will protect against IRI.

pmc-10647743.title: Early Detection of Rice Blast Using a Semi-Supervised Contrastive Unpaired Translation Iterative Network Based on UAV Images
pmc-10647743.creator: Shaodan Lin, Jiayi Li, Deyao Huang, Zuxin Cheng, Lirong Xiang, Dapeng Ye, Haiyong Weng, Vittorio Rossi
pmc-10647743.description: Rice blast has caused major production losses in rice, and thus the early detection of rice blast plays a crucial role in global food security. In this study, a semi-supervised contrastive unpaired translation iterative network is specifically designed based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images for rice blast detection.

pmc-11462644.description: The contribution of age‐related structural brain changes to the well‐established link between aging and cognitive decline is not fully defined. pmc-11677994.creator: Béla E. Tóth, István Takács, Kristóf Kádár, Sara Mirani, Miklós Vecsernyés, Péter Lakatos
pmc-11677994.description: Background/Objectives: Epidemiological data on vitamin D status revealed that, despite various dosage and durations of supplementation, the effectiveness often fails to achieve optimal outcomes. The need for higher doses than previously recommended was suggested, but several modifying factors should be considered, including the level of deficiency, and BMI.

pmc-13310251.creator: Mehran Molavand, Maryam Majidinia, Bahman Yousefi

pmc-13627171.title: Scleral image analysis via artificial intelligence to evaluate inflammatory status in inflammatory bowel disease
pmc-13627171.creator: Ying Li, Pinyi Huang, Lei Wang, Shuijiao Chen, Guanghui Lian, Fujun Li, Xiaowei Liu, Fanggen Lu, Yani Yin
pmc-13627171.description: PurposeAmong the extraintestinal ocular manifestations of patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), episcleritis is associated with the inflammatory activity of IBD. This study aims to provide a new approach for evaluating IBD inflammation by analyzing scleral images.
